metadata.question: Was the vegetation anomaly in February 21-28 2019 (compared to the long-term average of the same month from 2003-2017) worse in Namibia than Zimbabwe?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare vegetation anomalies between Namibia and Zimbabwe for February 21-28, 2019 compared to the long-term average (2003-2017) for the same period. This requires: 1. Data: MODIS NDVI (MOD13Q1) would be good for long-term vegetation monitoring 2. Strategy: - Calculate mean NDVI for Feb 21-28 period in 2019 for both countries - Calculate long-term mean NDVI for Feb 21-28 period from 2003-2017 for both countries - Compute anomaly as (2019_value - long_term_mean) / long_term_mean - Compare which country has the more negative anomaly 3. Steps: - Define geometries for Namibia and Zimbabwe - Load MOD13Q1 collection - Filter for target period (2019-02-21 to 2019-02-28) - Filter for baseline period (2003-02-21 to 2017-02-28, each year) - Calculate means and anomalies - Compare which anomaly is more negative 4. Data quality checks: - Check if collections are empty - Check if valid pixels exist after masking - Validate that NDVI values are in reasonable range (-1 to 1) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define countries const countries = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0'); const namibia = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Namibia')); const zimbabwe = countries.filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Zimbabwe')); // Load MODIS NDVI data const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13Q1') .select('NDVI'); // Function to filter Feb 21-28 period function filterFebPeriod(collection) { return collection.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(21, 28, 'day_of_month')); } // Target period (2019) const target2019 = filterFebPeriod(modis.filterDate('2019-02-01', '2019-02-28')); // Baseline period (2003-2017) const baseline = filterFebPeriod(modis.filterDate('2003-02-01', '2017-02-28')); // Check data availability const targetCount = target2019.size().getInfo(); const baselineCount = baseline.size().getInfo(); print(`Target 2019 images: ${targetCount}, Baseline images: ${baselineCount}`); if (targetCount === 0 || baselineCount === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Calculate baseline mean NDVI for each country const baselineMean = baseline.mean().multiply(0.0001); // Scale factor for MODIS NDVI // Calculate 2019 mean NDVI for each country const target2019Mean = target2019.mean().multiply(0.0001); // Function to calculate anomaly and stats function calculateAnomalyStats(country, countryName) { const baselineVal = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: country, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const targetVal = target2019Mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: country, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); const pixelCount = baselineMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: country, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI'); return { baseline: baselineVal, target: targetVal, pixelCount: pixelCount }; } // Calculate for both countries const namibiaStats = calculateAnomalyStats(namibia, 'Namibia'); const zimbabweStats = calculateAnomalyStats(zimbabwe, 'Zimbabwe'); const namibiaBaseline = namibiaStats.baseline.getInfo(); const namibiaTarget = namibiaStats.target.getInfo(); const namibiaPixels = namibiaStats.pixelCount.getInfo(); const zimbabweBaseline = zimbabweStats.baseline.getInfo(); const zimbabweTarget = zimbabweStats.target.getInfo(); const zimbabwePixels = zimbabweStats.pixelCount.getInfo(); print(`Namibia - Baseline NDVI: ${namibiaBaseline?.toFixed(3)}, 2019 NDVI: ${namibiaTarget?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${namibiaPixels}`); print(`Zimbabwe - Baseline NDVI: ${zimbabweBaseline?.toFixed(3)}, 2019 NDVI: ${zimbabweTarget?.toFixed(3)}, Pixels: ${zimbabwePixels}`); // Check for valid pixels if (namibiaPixels === 0 || zimbabwePixels === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (namibiaBaseline === null || namibiaTarget === null || zimbabweBaseline === null || zimbabweTarget === null || isNaN(namibiaBaseline) || isNaN(namibiaTarget) || isNaN(zimbabweBaseline) || isNaN(zimbabweTarget)) { print("C3"); return; } // Validate NDVI range if (namibiaBaseline < -1 || namibiaBaseline > 1 || namibiaTarget < -1 || namibiaTarget > 1 || zimbabweBaseline < -1 || zimbabweBaseline > 1 || zimbabweTarget < -1 || zimbabweTarget > 1) { print("C3"); return; } // Calculate anomalies (negative means worse vegetation) const namibiaAnomaly = (namibiaTarget - namibiaBaseline) / namibiaBaseline; const zimbabweAnomaly = (zimbabweTarget - zimbabweBaseline) / zimbabweBaseline; print(`Namibia anomaly: ${(namibiaAnomaly * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); print(`Zimbabwe anomaly: ${(zimbabweAnomaly * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); // Determine if Namibia anomaly is worse (more negative) if (namibiaAnomaly < zimbabweAnomaly) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
